description: Fact-check every factual claim in a block of text, such as an AI-generated draft or document before it is published or acted on, and return a per-claim report. Opt-in AI service: a language model labels each source's stance. Claims are extracted automatically. Each reported claim carries a verdict, sufficiency (anything but sufficient is a reason to abstain or escalate) and a conformal guarantee when certified. The calibration set holds no finance figures. The whole response is covered by a signed receipt bound to a hash of the submitted text, so it can later prove which document was checked. Limits: only declarative factual sentences are checked (questions, opinions and instructions are skipped), at most max_claims of them, and evidence comes from web, encyclopedic and news sources, so very recent, private, niche or opinion claims come back unverified or insufficient. Paid per call (x402): an unpaid call returns the payment offer.

max_claims.description: Max number of extracted claims to verify (1-20).

text.description: The prose whose factual claims should be extracted and checked.
